# Form145Form146.com ({{BRAND}})

> Form 145 and Form 146 are the new names (from 1 April 2026, Income-tax Act 2025 / Income-tax Rules 2026) for Form 15CA and Form 15CB, the declaration and Chartered Accountant certificate Indian banks require before most taxable remittances abroad. {{BRAND}} prepares both for NRIs and businesses: Form 145 filing free, Form 146 with full bank paperwork ₹999 (₹499 via partner banks), certificate in 24-48 hours.

## Facts
- NRIs can repatriate up to USD 1 million per financial year from NRO balances after tax.
- NRE/FCNR balances are freely repatriable and usually need no Form 145/146.
- Form 146 must be signed by a practising Chartered Accountant with a UDIN.
- Contact: +91 78900 00890 (phone/WhatsApp), info@form145form146.com
